top_stories.title: Criminal marketplace sells infostealer logs with AI-written profiles of their owners
top_stories.summary: A criminal marketplace is selling infostealer malware logs bundled with AI-generated profiles of victims, identifying where they work and which accounts are valuable targets. The service allows buyers to search victim profiles in plain language, effectively lowering the barrier to credential-based attacks against enterprise accounts.

top_stories.title: Citrix Patches 12 NetScaler and Secure Access Client Flaws, Including Authentication Bypass
top_stories.summary: Citrix has released patches for multiple critical security flaws in NetScaler ADC, NetScaler Gateway, and NetScaler Console, including an authentication bypass vulnerability. The authentication bypass flaw (CVE-2026-120868) carries a CVSS score of 9.3, alongside other vulnerabilities that could lead to denial-of-service conditions.

top_stories.title: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Auth0, Okta, and Palo Alto Networks
top_stories.summary: AWS Secrets Manager has added managed external secrets support for Auth0, Okta, and Palo Alto Networks. The feature addresses the security risk of long-lived, unrotated credentials by enabling coordinated rotation of third-party credentials directly within AWS Secrets Manager.

top_stories.title: AI agents are becoming identities in their own right, and security needs to catch up
top_stories.summary: AI agents are increasingly being treated as distinct identities requiring their own access management frameworks, including constrained permissions and oversight mechanisms. This represents a growing area of IAM practice as agentic AI systems require identity governance, authorization controls, and security policies similar to those applied to human and service account identities.

top_stories.title: Extortion Group Luna Moth Flits Into Law Firms a Second Time
top_stories.summary: The Luna Moth extortion group is targeting law firms using social engineering tactics designed to steal Microsoft access tokens. The attack method focuses on credential and token theft to gain unauthorized access, bypassing traditional authentication controls.

news.title: Apple splits Mac app permissions fearing overreaching AI agents
news.summary: Apple has introduced more granular permissions for Device Control, Data Access, and Full Disk Access in macOS 26.3 beta 2 to address overly broad app access. The changes were prompted by concerns that developers were using Full Disk Access to expose sensitive user files, emails, and browsing history, with AI agents expected to increase these risks.

news.title: 40% of organizations struggle to retrace AI agents’ actions
news.summary: Palo Alto Networks' State of Cloud Security Report 2026 found that 99% of organizations use AI agents for autonomous or semiautonomous actions in development pipelines, with 40% unable to retrace those agents' actions. Nearly three-quarters of organizations grant AI agents permission to modify code, CI/CD configurations, or deploy applications to production, raising concerns about access controls and auditability.

news.title: Apple Tightens macOS App Permissions to Limit Data Access Amid AI Agent Security Risks
news.summary: Apple has introduced new granular app permission controls in macOS 26.3 beta 2, targeting Device Control, Data Access, and Full Disk Access APIs. The changes aim to limit how much data apps, including AI agents, can access on Mac systems.

news.title: 7 Tips For Complying with CJIS Password and MFA Requirements
news.summary: The FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy requires law enforcement agencies to implement stronger password protections and enforce MFA across privileged and non-privileged accounts. Specops Software has published seven practical steps for meeting these requirements, including blocking compromised passwords and maintaining ongoing compliance.

news.title: Cursor Says Stolen Fireworks AI Key Led to Trojanized Claude Code Extension Incident
news.summary: A stolen access key issued to Fireworks AI was used by an attacker to compromise Anthropic's Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace. The key was exposed through a breach at Fireworks AI, allowing the attacker to copy data from a read-only source and distribute a trojanized extension.

news.title: Fake AI event invites target Microsoft and Google logins
news.summary: A phishing campaign uses fake OpenAI event pages offering free ChatGPT Pro subscriptions to harvest Microsoft and Google account credentials from employees. The attack specifically targets corporate identity providers by tricking users into submitting their Microsoft and Google login credentials on fraudulent pages.

news.title: The Security Jobs Growing Around Enterprise AI Agents
news.summary: Enterprise AI agents are driving new security job roles as AI systems now access shared mailboxes, SharePoint, and ticketing systems beyond simple chat interfaces. Managing identity and access permissions for AI agents is emerging as a distinct security challenge within enterprise environments.

news.title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
news.summary: The FBI attributed over $400 million in cryptocurrency theft to North Korean threat actors using a social engineering scheme called FaceStealer, which employed deepfake video calls. The campaign relied on identity deception tactics to manipulate victims, carried out over an 18-month period.

news.title: When an AI Agent Goes Wrong, Can You Stop It?
news.summary: The article examines identity and authorization risks associated with AI agents, specifically focusing on how agent identities with broad access permissions can be manipulated into performing unintended actions. The scenario described highlights the challenge of scoping and controlling AI agent permissions within IAM frameworks.

news.title: SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
news.summary: A threat actor called SilentAir has been intercepting SMS-based two-factor authentication codes by compromising equipment inside Asian mobile operators, primarily targeting users in Taiwan. Enea, a Stockholm-based telecom and cybersecurity firm, identified attack sources in at least six Asian countries and assessed with high confidence that SilentAir is a state-level actor.

news.title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
news.summary: An international law enforcement operation dismantled servers behind Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC malware, which were used to steal passwords and deploy ransomware. Authorities seized approximately 6.4 million stolen login credentials belonging to over 40,000 victims, according to Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office (BKA).

news.title: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock offers built-in cost attribution that traces every inference call back to the IAM principal responsible, enabling per-user cost tracking for AI tools. The solution leverages IAM Identity Center to associate Bedrock usage costs with individual users or roles without requiring additional instrumentation.

news.title: Webinar: See How Identity Blind Spots Put Your SOC at Risk and How to Close Them
news.summary: A webinar is being promoted around the topic of identity blind spots in security operations centers (SOCs). The session focuses on challenges security teams face in identifying who or what is behind suspicious activity, including human accounts, machine accounts, and AI agents with access to sensitive systems.

news.title: New SignDrop Zero-Day Exploit Turns Windows CLFS Security Feature Into SYSTEM Access
news.summary: A proof-of-concept exploit called SignDrop has been released that claims to allow local Windows users to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level via the Common Log File System (CLFS) driver. The exploit abuses a log-authentication feature in clfs.sys by using path redirection when a privileged process opens a prepared log file.

news.title: Your Endpoint Management Platform Could Be Your Biggest Security Risk
news.summary: Action1 published content warning that endpoint management platforms pose significant security risks if compromised, enabling malware deployment and mass device disruption. The piece promotes customer-controlled cryptographic authorization as a mitigation approach.

news.title: AI Coding Agents Leak Thousands of Secrets to GitHub
news.summary: A command in Claude Code inadvertently saves files containing credentials and other sensitive data to public GitHub repositories. This creates credential exposure risks for organizations using AI coding agents, as secrets intended to remain private are leaked to publicly accessible repositories.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws. The update includes a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, alongside patches from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.
